title: Derivative of the mollification of a Lipschitz function: D(ρ⋆f)(x)v = ∫ρ(t)·Df(x−t)v dt
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, f : ℝᵏ → ℝ L-Lipschitz and ρ : ℝᵏ → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support (ℝᵏ = Euclid k with Lebesgue measure). Put f_ρ(y) := ∫ ρ(t)·f(y − t) dt. Then for all x, v ∈ ℝᵏ, Df_ρ(x)v = ∫ ρ(t)·Df(x − t)v dt, where D = fderiv ℝ (Df(z) is the zero map where f is not differentiable).
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (f ρ : Euclid k → ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → ∀ x v : Euclid k, fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∫ t, ρ t * f (y - t)) x v = ∫ t, ρ t * fderiv ℝ f (x - t) v
